riskFlags.detail: The monitoring report is textually identical (similarity 1.0) to the report on cookstove-ke-001 and is registered to that project, not this one (provenance: MISATTRIBUTED). The same evidence is being used to claim credits twice.

The only evidence submitted for cookstove-ke-004 was issued for another project by another auditor's registration, so no report verifiably covers this project's 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30 monitoring period.

The report describes 2,300 stoves in Kibera and firewood use falling from 6.1 to 3.4 kg/day, but it was issued for cookstove-ke-001 and does not reference this project. Its monitoring period and this submission's period are not shown to match.
Developer opportunist-dev has three prior REJECTED projects (forest-br-004: inflated baseline and inconsistent evidence; methane-br-001-copy1: reused evidence; forest-tr-002: overlapping project).

attestation.explanation: The only monitoring report submitted for this project is an exact copy of the report registered to a different project (cookstove-ke-001), so it does not prove any reduction here. The developer also has a history of rejected projects with reused evidence, inflated baselines, and overlaps, so no credits should be minted.
